name: Strategy001: EMA20/50 cross + Heikin-Ashi confirmation
one_line: Enter when EMA20 crosses above EMA50, HA close above EMA20 and HA bar green; exit on EMA50/100 cross with red HA bar.

source.license: GPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE). Only ideas are summarised here; no code copied.

idea: Cross-over of medium EMAs confirmed by smoothed candle colour; ROI table plus -10% stoploss do most of the exiting.

rules.name: ha_confirmation
rules.description: Heikin-Ashi close > EMA20 and HA open < HA close

rules.name: ema_cross_exit
rules.description: EMA50 crosses above EMA100 with HA close < EMA20 and red HA bar

evidence: No performance data in the repo; README says examples are educational and not for real money.
limitations: exit logic is odd (EMA50 crossing above EMA100 is a bullish event)

pipeline_fit.notes: Daily version: needs fixed EMAs, dedicated named rules; treat the unusual exit as a defect to avoid.
